newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: Indian metals trade was closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival, dealers said.
The markets will reopen on Thursday.
On Tuesday, copper prices extended losses while other base metals were unchanged in narrow trade, dealers said.

Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 12,600 rupees per quintal on sluggish demand and fresh offerings, after a similar fall on Monday. Nickel was steady at the improved level of 38,500 rupees, after gaining on 100 rupees on Monday. Tin was unchanged at 35,600 rupees, zinc at 6,300 rupees and lead at 4,850 rupees, on limited activity. Aluminium was quiet at 7,450 rupees.
